# TelegramBase

> Mini PHP 8.1+ framework for Telegram bot development — plugin system, queue backends (JSON/Redis/RabbitMQ/Memcached), validated webhooks, i18n, caching, sessions, middleware, scheduler, migrations, and CLI scaffolding. Built on Illuminate (Laravel) components. Every processing path has a measured, documented delivery guarantee (at-least-once vs at-most-once).

## Key facts

- Language: PHP 8.1+, Composer; extensions `json`, `mbstring`, `curl` (optional: `redis`, `memcached`, `amqp`, `pdo_mysql`)
- Current version: **v2.4.0** (see CHANGELOG.md)
- Entry points: `bot.php` (CLI modes), `webhook.php` (HTTP), `queue.php` (queue producer), `bin/tgbase` (CLI tooling), `bin/scheduler.php` (cron)
- Modes via `BOT_MODE`: `update_direct`, `update_queue`, `webhook_direct`, `webhook_queue`, `cronjob_update`, `cronjob_queue`
- SAPI guard: CLI-only modes on the webhook entry return HTTP 500 — never an infinite loop
- RabbitMQ pipeline: at-least-once (ack-after-process); Redis/JSON/Memcached queues: at-most-once (destructive pop)
- Plugins: plain classes in `Plugin/`, auto-discovered, `#[ChatType]` attribute filtering, priority-ordered handlers (`onMessage`, `onCallback_query`, `onCommand`, `before`, `after`)
- Retry queue for transient API failures (429/5xx/timeout) honoring Telegram's `retry_after`
- Tests: dependency-free runner (`php tests/run.php`, `--filter=`), opt-in live Telegram tests, GitHub Actions CI (PHP 8.1–8.4)

## Documentation

- Documentation is multilingual: `docs/en/` (canonical), plus complete sets in `docs/fa/`, `docs/zh/`, `docs/ru/`, `docs/fr/`, `docs/pt/`, `docs/ar/` — language hub at [docs/README.md](docs/README.md); per-language READMEs (`README.fa.md`, `README.zh.md`, `README.ru.md`, `README.fr.md`, `README.pt.md`, `README.ar.md`).

- [README.md](README.md): project intro, quick start, docs index
- [docs/overview.md](docs/en/overview.md): what the framework is, what it does, what it deliberately doesn't do
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/en/architecture.md): boot sequence, update flow diagram, component map of `App/`
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/en/getting-started.md): install → first plugin → deploy step by step
- [docs/bot-modes.md](docs/en/bot-modes.md): all six `BOT_MODE`s, entry points, the SAPI guard, delivery semantics per path
- [docs/plugins.md](docs/en/plugins.md): plugin authoring — handlers, priority, `#[ChatType]`, discovery rules
- [docs/queue-pipeline.md](docs/en/queue-pipeline.md): queue backends, the RabbitMQ ack contract, retry queue, bounded queues
- [docs/webhook.md](docs/en/webhook.md): webhook setup, the 5 validation layers, Cloudflare/proxy notes, response semantics
- [docs/reliability.md](docs/en/reliability.md): crash-test results, delivery guarantees, idempotency recipes
- [docs/configuration.md](docs/en/configuration.md): full `.env` reference with defaults
- [docs/features.md](docs/en/features.md): sessions, keyboards, middleware, cache, i18n, scheduler, database, CLI
- [docs/caching.md](docs/en/caching.md): CacheManager — drivers, config, TTL semantics, flush reach per driver, cross-process persistence matrix (live-verified)
- [docs/sessions.md](docs/en/sessions.md): SessionManager API, multi-step flows, which driver you need, security notes
- [docs/i18n.md](docs/en/i18n.md): language file layout, `__()` helper, LANG_DRIVER pitfall, per-user language, cache behavior
- [docs/buttons.md](docs/en/buttons.md): Keyboard builder API, ButtonManager/btn() file menus, callback handling, caching
- [docs/multi-bot.md](docs/en/multi-bot.md): BotManager, BOT_EXTRA_BOTS, token stack, live-verified cross-bot scenarios; token-management strategy matrix (static .env / dynamic add() / Managed Bots) and Bot API 9.6 Managed Bots support (onManagedBot, registerManagedBot, requestManagedBot)
- [docs/testing.md](docs/en/testing.md): offline suite, live tests, CI, known suite drift
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/en/troubleshooting.md): symptoms → causes → fixes
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history (starts at v2.4.0)

## Optional

- [.env.example](.env.example): every configuration key with defaults and comments
- [examples/HelloBot.php](examples/HelloBot.php): complete example plugin (commands, inline keyboard, sessions, retry helper, callbacks)
- [integration/TestBot/](integration/TestBot/README.md): real-bot integration harness (opt-in, isolated `Plugin/` dir)
- [llms-ctx.txt](llms-ctx.txt): single-file flattened context (README + all docs) for LLM ingestion without file access
